omissions_or_limits: Only the frozen raw responses and supplied candidate/citation links were examined. No truth-check, hidden condition information, external browsing, gold, outcomes, other extraction files or git history was used.

Pure advice, rankings, subjective fit, question restatements, illustrative code, hypothetical designs and process-only retrieval/test statements are excluded. Unverified product propositions are separated from factual assertions. Historical evidence limits do not establish product unavailability.

Source offsets are zero-based Unicode code-point positions, end-exclusive. URLs indicate actually supplied references, not verified support; section-level sources are retained when the answer does not allocate them more narrowly.
